subject: Evaluation plan & milestone discount request — AnthemTech
messages:
From: Jill Parsons <jill.parsons@anthemtech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rami Singh <rami.singh@anthemtech.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation plan & early commit pricing?

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look very promising for our chat assistant pilot. We’re putting together an internal evaluation plan and want to understand whether Redwood can support a short pilot with an early-commit discount tied to MAP milestones. High-level ask: a three-month eval (pilot) that transitions to a paid ramp if we hit agreed milestones (monthly active users, tokens/month).

Specifically: can you share a recommended MAP with milestone definitions, suggested success criteria, and what discounts/redemptions you’d entertain for a 6–12 month commit following a successful pilot? Our procurement will want to see an approximate cost model ahead of any exec approvals.

If helpful, our goals for the pilot: 50k MAU-equivalent interactions/month by week 12, P50 latency < 350ms, and no PII retention beyond session (we’ll provide SOC2 checklist later).

Thanks — can you put something in writing we can show procurement/legal?

— Jill
Sr. Product Manager, AnthemTech

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Parsons <jill.parsons@anthemtech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan & early commit pricing?

Hi Jill — great to meet yesterday, and glad the numbers looked close to what you need. Below is a short MAP we typically propose for pilots that convert to a committed ramp. I’ve also looped in Laura on the commercial side to help with timeline and exec path.

Proposed MAP (pilot -> ramp):
- Week 0: Kickoff + security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence to be provided by AnthemTech)
- Weeks 1–4: Integration & smoke tests (initial traffic up to 5k interactions/day)
- Weeks 5–8 (M1): Stability milestone — <1% error rate at 5k/day; Redwood provides model tuning support
- Weeks 9–12 (M2): Scale milestone — sustained 50k interactions/month; P50 latency target met
- Week 12 (M3): Business milestone — product sign-off by AnthemTech PM and readiness to commit to a 6–12 month ramp

Commercial proposal (pilot):
- Pilot pricing: pay-as-you-go hosted rates (standard) with credit back if M2 met
- Early-commit discount request: AnthemTech asked for a 25% discount on inference unit price for first 3 months after commit if M3 achieved. They will commit to a 6-month minimum ramp schedule with target token volumes that we can model.

Request: I need internal sign-off on the 25% early-commit concession to propose to AnthemTech. Can Ben (VP Sales) and Marissa (Finance) review margin impact? If we require escalations to Rafael/CFO or Aditya for anything >20%, please advise.

Attachments: I don’t have a full cost model yet — I’ll ask procurement to share expected volumes and will circulate a simple cost projection.

Next steps: Ben/Marissa — can you reply with a quick yes/no on capability to support a 25% front-loaded discount with an accelerant (rebate) structure tied to the ramp?

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan & early commit pricing?

Karthik — thanks for the MAP outline, looks sensible. Quick thoughts:
- 25% up-front discount is aggressive for a net-new account at scale; I’d prefer a two-stage approach: 15% initial discount on month-1–3 post-commit, with a retroactive rebate that brings effective discount to 25% if AnthemTech hits the agreed ramp targets by month 6.
- Need an expected ARR and ARR ramp profile to model adoption cliffs — please add the expected monthly token volumes so I can estimate quota/capacity impacts.
- If finance flags margin pressure, we’ll loop Rafael.

Agree we can present the MAP + conditional pricing to the customer; better to keep the first offer conservative and show upside if milestones are exceeded.

Ben
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T16:30:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan & early commit pricing? — finance model attached

Ben/Karthik — I ran a quick margin model with the following assumptions (see attached):
- Baseline inference unit cost: $0.0008 / token (current hosted stack average for the targeted model family)
- Current list price we would charge: $0.0016 / token
- 15% discount => $0.00136 / token (gross margin around ~15%)
- 25% discount => $0.0012 / token (gross margin closer to ~10%)

If AnthemTech is only committing to a 6-month ramp with modest volumes (~50m tokens/month at steady state), 25% front-loaded would materially compress gross margin. I recommend the two-stage approach Ben suggested: 15% initial, with a performance rebate that scales up to 25% retroactively if token thresholds are met at month 6.

I’ve attached the model: anthemtech-pricing-model.xlsx (attachment stub). Rafael, can you confirm whether finance is comfortable with the rebate structure and whether we need CEO approval for any concession beyond 20%?

— Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T14:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan & early commit pricing? — finance recommendation

Thanks team — reviewed Marissa’s model. Summary:
- Approve rebateable two-stage structure: 15% guaranteed initial discount for months 1–3 post-commit, with a retroactive rebate up to 25% if ramp targets (tokens/month and invoiced revenue thresholds) are met by month 6.
- For clarity: any effective customer discount >20% at contract signature requires CEO sign-off per our commercial policy.
- I’ve cc’d Aditya because this request straddles policy (we can offer 20% programmatically; >20% needs CEO sign-off).

If Aditya is OK with making an exception to 20% for strategic reasons (large logo, reference, cloud marketplace tie-in), we can go to 25% effective. Otherwise we present the two-stage plan with a maximum 20% guaranteed discount and an additional performance rebate that can bring them to 25% post-facto.

Rafael
VP Finance (interim), Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan & early commit pricing? — final approval

Thanks all — I reviewed the MAP and the finance model. Given AnthemTech’s strategic fit and the potential long-term ARR, I will approve a front-loaded structure that targets 22% guaranteed discount for months 1–3 post-commit, with an additional retroactive rebate up to 25% if they hit the full ramp thresholds by month 6. Conditions:
- We require the term sheet (attached) to include clawbacks if milestone reporting is not timely or if volumes fall by >30% during ramp; legal to prepare standard language.
- Pricing to be executed in DocuSign and contingent on receiving the SOC2 evidence and a signed mutual action plan.

Karthik — you can present this to AnthemTech as our executive-approved concession (22% guaranteed -> up to 25% with performance). Please ask procurement to upload volumes, and get legal to prepare the term sheet.

Aditya
CEO, Redwood Inference

From: Jill Parsons <jill.parsons@anthemtech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rami Singh <rami.singh@anthemtech.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T23:20:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan & early commit pricing? — acceptance

Karthik / Aditya — thank you. That structure is acceptable to AnthemTech. We accept the 22% guaranteed discount for months 1–3 and the performance rebate to reach 25% contingent on hitting the MAP milestones by month 6. Please send the DocuSign term sheet and the pricing model you referenced; we’ll assign legal to review the clawback language and confirm SOC2 evidentiary timing.

Next steps: can Redwood send the DocuSign link and the finalized MAP by EOD Friday? We’ll aim to return a signed DocuSign within 72 hours of receipt.

— Jill
Sr. Product Manager, AnthemTech
